name: Goliath Water-Cooled
description: The Goliath Water-Cooled Hotend is designed by the VzBoT team and manufactured by Mellow3D for extreme volumetric flow rates, targeting ~100mm³/s or more. Water cooling replaces the traditional heat sink and fan, enabling a much larger melt zone without the risk of heat creep at high feed rates. Features a 50mm long melt zone, nickel-plated copper thermal block, 100W heater, and a bi-material copper-zirconia heatbreak. It is aimed at production and high-speed printing environments where maximum throughput is the priority.

heatBreakSpecs.material: copper-zirconia composite with water cooling jacket

physicalSpecs.mountType: Goliath / VzBoT proprietary (requires water cooling loop)

features: Water-cooled cold side eliminates heat creep at high speeds
Rated to 550°C for engineering and exotic filaments
Designed for high-speed and high-throughput applications
